hints.title: User-Partitioned Tasks
hints.text: Maintain task records indexed by user identifier, along with a global task counter for generating unique task ids.

hints.title: Task Metadata Tracking
hints.text: For each task, store its description, due date, tags, and completion flag.

hints.title: Ordered Retrieval
hints.text: When querying tasks, filter out completed tasks (and optionally match tags), then sort by due date ascending.

hints.title: Todo List Class Implementation

complexity.time: O(m log m) for retrieval, O(1) for adding and completing
variables: m: number of tasks for user
N: total tasks across all users
complexity.notes: Sorting uncompleted tasks takes O(m log m); insertions and completion updates take O(1).
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Scanning tasks of other users causes unnecessary time complexity.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(N) dictionary storage for tasks and user mappings.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Maintains user partition and returns uncompleted tasks ordered by due date.
